hold_reason: Refund for order 243 (13498 cents) is in the signed Alpha batch but is absent from the refund ledger. Handoff reported only orders 240 and 245 as applied. Paying net balances now could overpay the customer on order 243. Needs review and confirmation of whether 243's refund should be applied before any payouts.

reply.thought: The handoff reports only refunds 240 and 245 as applied, but the signed batch also requested a refund for order 243 (13498 cents). Before paying anyone, I'll check the refund ledger directly to see whether 243 is actually missing.

The ledger confirms refund 243 (13498 cents) was requested in the signed batch but is not applied. Paying out now could overpay the customer on that order, and payouts cannot be recalled, so I'm stopping the batch for human review.
